_schema.generated: ISO timestamp of the daily refresh; the page shows it and flags >=2d stale
_schema.tickers: map of ticker id -> array of news items, any order (the page sorts newest-first and filters to the last 7 days)

item.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the news broke (the page joins this to own price data for the 1d move)
item.headline: one line, what happened
item.why: optional, one line on why it matters for this name
item.src: publication or filing the item came from - required for anything asserted as fact

META.headline: Instagram launches Direct, a standalone messaging app for one-on-one and group chats
META.why: A new messaging surface from Meta; the post gives no usage, monetization or financial detail.

META.headline: Meta says it is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero goal after AI buildout lifted emissions 45% in 2025
META.why: The 2026 sustainability report ties the rethink to data-center growth and stalled clean-energy deployment. Entergy is pursuing more than 5.2 GW of gas units in Louisiana to serve Meta.

META.headline: Meta agrees not to issue Class C shares while Delaware shareholder suits are pending; trial proposed April 2027
META.why: Delays the non-voting share plan meant for capital raising, compensation and M&A; CalSTRS and PFA are among the challengers. The restated charter (effective 2027-01-19) is unaffected.

NVDA.headline: House Foreign Affairs Committee releases data: US approved about 879,000 Nvidia and AMD AI chips for China out of 3.4M requested
NVDA.why: The release shows how many chips were licensed for China; reports say Nvidia has already stopped shipping H200s there, and its Q4 outlook assumes no China Data Center compute revenue.
NVDA.src: House Foreign Affairs Committee (Al Jazeera, Benzinga coverage)

NVDA.headline: Analysts reset NVDA targets after earnings: Freedom Broker cuts to $230 from $305, Buy kept
NVDA.why: Reported post-earnings target moves, with Lynx Equity's cut to $135 attributed to leadership-transition uncertainty. The dates and figures come from aggregator pages, not the firms' own notes.

AAPL.headline: Apple unveils first touchscreen MacBook Pro (OLED) and new iMac with M6 chip
AAPL.why: Opens a new premium-priced Mac upgrade cycle, with 14"/16" MacBook Pro starting at $2,899

AAPL.headline: Evercore ISI reiterates Outperform, raises AAPL target to $380 after new Mac launch
AAPL.why: Sell-side target hike signals confidence in Mac refresh ahead of Nov 2 fiscal Q4 earnings

AAPL.headline: Counterpoint: iPhone 18 Pro global sales growth slows to 3.1% three weeks post-launch
AAPL.why: US sales down 4% offset by China growth, a demand signal ahead of Apple's Nov 2 earnings report

AAPL.headline: iPhone Duo resale premiums in China collapse days after launch, some orders canceled
AAPL.why: Fading scalper demand suggests cooling enthusiasm for Apple's first foldable in a key growth market

MSFT.headline: Microsoft prices $25B senior notes offering to help fund AI infrastructure buildout
MSFT.why: New debt load tied to a reported ~$170B 2026 capex target signals sustained heavy AI spending ahead

MSFT.headline: Microsoft Q1 FY2027 revenue $92.3B beats estimates; Azure growth accelerates to 48% YoY
MSFT.why: Cloud reacceleration (Microsoft Cloud revenue $63.9B, +30% YoY) is the core AI-demand thesis for MSFT, though capex hit $45.2B and free cash flow fell 27% YoY

MSFT.headline: Microsoft says OpenAI generated ~$10B of revenue, about 11% of total quarterly revenue
MSFT.why: Shows growing customer-concentration exposure to OpenAI; OpenAI still owes Microsoft over $7B in unpaid bills

MSFT.headline: Bernstein raises Microsoft price target to $722 from $662, keeps Outperform
MSFT.why: Sell-side reaction ahead of earnings reflects rising expectations for Azure/AI growth

GOOGL.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, a mid-tier Gemini 4 model, via API, Gemini app and Antigravity
GOOGL.why: Google positions Neon between Carbon and Hydrogen on depth versus efficiency. Google's published benchmarks show it ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol on most tests, and API pricing is reported at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.

GOOGL.headline: Alphabet-owned Isomorphic Labs announces $5B Series C led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, with GV and CapitalG participating
GOOGL.why: Large outside funding round for an Alphabet-owned AI drug-discovery unit, six months after its $2.1B May round. Sources say no valuation was disclosed.

AMZN.headline: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq (ANT) after a $107.3B IPO; Amazon reported to hold about 14.6% of it
AMZN.why: Amazon's mostly non-voting stake is carried at about $190B on its books; Motley Fool puts it near $394B at a $2T valuation (Amazon does not disclose its percentage).

AMD.headline: AMD files S-3 registering up to ~337M shares for resale, mostly OpenAI and Meta warrants; stock falls about 9-10% on Nov 24
AMD.why: The shares are mainly 160M warrants each for OpenAI and Meta at $0.01, which vest as they buy Instinct GPUs. The filing is about 20% of shares outstanding. AMD is not selling stock itself.

AMD.headline: Hunterbrook short report alleges AMD firmware reached Entity-Listed China server maker IEIT; AMD denies, shares fall
AMD.why: Report alleges export-control exposure and says over 20% of AMD revenue is billed to China/HK customers. Reuters could not verify it, and AMD says it complies with export laws.

AVGO.headline: Broadcom falls about 12% after analyst Ming-Chi Kuo says Google cut 2027 TPU 8i volume by roughly 1M chips (about 20%)
AVGO.why: Unconfirmed supply-chain estimate; Kuo says volume shifts to MediaTek-designed TPU 8t chips. Google and Broadcom have not commented, and Broadcom's Dec 9 FQ4 print is the first chance to address it.

INTC.headline: Intel CEO Tan says Intel has signed its first outside customer for 18A; CTO later says it is 18A-P
INTC.why: First external 18A-family customer is unnamed, and no volume, value or timing was disclosed. Intel did not say how it differs from Socionext's August 18A-P commitment.

INTC.headline: Intel names Microsoft as first publicly named customer for its EMIB advanced packaging
INTC.why: This is a named external customer for Intel Foundry's packaging business. No terms were disclosed in the coverage I found.

TSM.headline: New US BIS rule prompts TSMC and Samsung to pause some chip shipments to Chinese customers pending export licences
TSM.why: The rule removes a transistor-count self-clearance route. TSMC is reportedly limiting affected Chinese designers to older nodes, which puts China-linked revenue at risk. Reports differ on the exact node cutoff, and in-transit goods can ship under old terms until Dec 21.

MRVL.headline: Lumentum CEO defends $115B all-stock Marvell deal after stock plunge: 'We've got work to do' with shareholders
MRVL.why: Deal needs approval from both companies' stockholders and is expected to close in 1H 2028, so the target's CEO is publicly saying shareholders still have to be won over.

9988.headline: Alibaba Sept-qtr revenue RMB271.5bn (+10%); AI Cloud & Compute revenue +53% to RMB60.97bn, external customers +64%
9988.why: Cloud growth is the core of the AI thesis; the release also gives non-GAAP net income of RMB19.9bn (+92%). One outlet reports adjusted EPS missed some estimates, and another reports free cash flow of -RMB34.5bn.

9988.headline: Management reportedly sees next-year cloud growth of 30-45%, down from 53%, and reaffirmed 2030 targets
9988.why: A slower cloud growth range would sit below the current run-rate. The 2030 targets are US$100bn external cloud revenue and 20%+ EBITDA margin. This comes from earnings-call reporting, not the filing.

0700.headline: Morgan Stanley cuts Tencent price target to HK$650 from HK$735, keeps Overweight
0700.why: Cites AI investment pressure cutting 2026-27 non-IFRS operating profit estimates by 6-7%, a read on near-term margin risk

0700.headline: Tencent launches ~$5B bond offering (USD and offshore yuan notes) mainly to fund AI capex
0700.why: Shows Tencent financing its AI buildout via debt rather than only cash flow, raising leverage to support capex

0700.headline: AI agent startup Manus raises $500M+ at ~$4B valuation with Tencent among investors
0700.why: Extends Tencent's strategic AI investment footprint following the collapse of Manus's Meta acquisition

0700.headline: DeepSeek nears $12B pre-IPO funding round backed by Tencent and CATL ahead of 2027 Shanghai listing
0700.why: Signals Tencent deepening its stake in a leading rival/partner AI model maker, adding to its AI investment portfolio exposure

3690.headline: Meituan announces board meeting on Nov 27 to approve Q3 2026 results, with a call that evening HK time
3690.why: Sets the date for the next hard data on food-delivery losses and the Q3 unit-economics guidance, ahead of the Nov 27 release.

9618.headline: JD.com's Double 11 mid-event report: AI hardware GMV up over 130% versus prior period
9618.why: Signals strong Q4 demand momentum in JD's AI-hardware category, a read-through for holiday-quarter revenue ahead of the Nov 12 Q3 print
